segmind.note: Official Segmind hosted MCP server (Streamable HTTP). Requires OAuth: on first connection you sign in to your Segmind account in the browser; no API key to paste. Segmind's authorization server does not offer dynamic client registration, so the plugin names its OAuth client by URL: a client ID metadata document Segmind serves at https://mcp.segmind.com/oauth/grok-build-client.json. Tools: list_models, compare_models, get_model_spec, run_inference, submit_inference, check_inference, list_pixelflows, get_pixelflow_spec, submit_pixelflow, check_pixelflow, validate_pixelflow, create_pixelflow, get_pixelflow, update_pixelflow, restore_pixelflow, publish_pixelflow, create_upload_ticket, upload_media, list_generations, list_request_history, get_account, ping.
